title: Git for Global Law
scheme: country (its English name; the ISO 3166-1 code is `code`) / level (federal, national, or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision) / corpus
date_rule: Root commits are in in-force order; the In-force trailer is authoritative (git cannot store dates before 1970).
future_rule: Only laws in force by 2026-10-28 are pinned; laws adopted but not yet in force stay on each corpus's future branch.

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactivity unless the law says so (法律不遡及の原則)
default_reach.meaning: an amendment applies from its enforcement day (施行日); how it treats facts and proceedings from before that day is set by the transitional provisions (経過措置) in the amending law's supplementary provisions (附則), which this record includes as suppl/<law>.md files but does not read as scope data; the Constitution bars retroactive criminal liability, and the general rule outside criminal law is a principle of interpretation, not a constitutional rule
default_reach.authority: 日本国憲法 第三十九条 ("第三十九条　何人も、実行の時に適法であつた行為又は既に無罪とされた行為については、刑事上の責任を問はれない。又、同一の犯罪について、重ねて刑事上の責任を問はれない。")
